theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Energy (+1.54%) and Communication Svcs (+0.96%) led the market today, while Health Care (-1.25%) and Industrials (-0.44%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.27%, defensives -0.18%, and value/cyclicals +0.27% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.08%, Dow -0.26%, Nasdaq -0.25% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at -0.30%. The VIX rose 1.38% to 15.42, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 0.71% to $4,181.20, crude oil was little changed at $94.24, and bitcoin gained 1.53% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
